mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) AS inputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS outputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(SUM(cost_amount), 0) AS costAmount, COUNT(DISTINCT currency) AS currencyCount, MIN(currency) AS currency, COUNT(*) AS rowCount FROM token_usage WHERE run_id = #{runId}
